findings.title: Mandatory verification checks are failing
findings.details: The verification contract marks both required checks `regression` and `placeholder-scan` as `passes: false`. The bundled evidence states full-repository regression does not pass and the placeholder scan exits 1 without the required human acceptance. A Default-FAIL contract with mandatory red checks cannot support completion.

findings.title: Verification contract is bound to a stale specification revision
findings.details: The contract pins `spec_revision` to `2740928c...`, while its own bundled disclosure identifies the current revision as `466465e0...` after acceptance-criteria amendments. The field was deliberately not refreshed, so the verification contract does not attest to the specification supplied for this review.

findings.title: The core Capability-matching path lacks execution-based verification
findings.details: REQ-005 requires one `evaluate-predicate` invocation for every Registry Capability × Project-Context component and unioning the results. The acceptance suite explicitly substitutes a simplified component-name equality simulation and never invokes or faithfully emulates the evaluator contract; static substring checks only show that the staged prose mentions the algorithm. Invocation cardinality, evaluator output handling, and real union-match behavior therefore remain unverified.
